title: Sebastian and the Kitchen
author: E. M. Okonkwo
blurb: Felix Eastwick, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
